title: After novel Oregon EPR ruling, attention turns to other legal battlegrounds
summary: Attorneys are unpacking how the judge’s opinion could possibly shape future legal arguments, while preliminary injunction pursuits remain pending in cases in California and Colorado.

title: Pactiv, Anchor made facility closure announcements in August
summary: Silgan also announced layoffs at a California metal container facility, but they are temporary.

title: 10 years in, ePac CEO touts success of digital printing focus
summary: CEO Virag Patel describes the desire to “embrace change” as ePac builds a new flagship facility in Phoenix following its acquisition by a private equity firm. It’s also navigating changes from technology, tariffs and EPR policies.

title: California bill cracking down on recycled content claims heads to Newsom
summary: AB 2253 “helps restore trust to product labels,” said Assemblymember Tasha Boerner. The bill addresses controversy with mass balance accounting and was widely opposed by packaging trade groups.

title: Paper, cardboard recycling rates were flat in 2025: AF&PA
summary: Recycling rates held steady despite declines in U.S. paper and paperboard production in 2025, which illustrates the industry’s resilience, according to the American Forest & Paper Association.

title: Consumers increasingly prioritize sustainability for e-commerce packaging: Ryder
summary: While consumers still seek value amid economic uncertainty, it’s a lower priority than last year, the logistics company found in a survey. Boxes remained consumers’ preferred e-commerce packaging format, but the reasons shifted.

title: Nippon Dynawave was aware of tank wall concerns, CSB finds
summary: The U.S. Chemical Safety and Hazard Investigation Board is “greatly concerned” by interim findings regarding a deadly implosion in May, namely the company’s lack of attention to an issue raised during inspections.

title: Oregon EPR law doesn’t violate Constitution, judge rules
summary: The federal judge disagreed with plaintiff National Association of Wholesaler-Distributors’ claims, saying Oregon showed “innovative leadership” with its EPR law. The decision could influence other in-progress litigation over EPR laws.

title: Messy EPR process provides opportunities for brands, recyclers
summary: Moving forward with packaging EPR implementation is a complex process but one that offers new ways to build better systems for long-term recycling improvements, speakers said during a Be Waste Wise panel on Wednesday.

title: Nippon Dynawave cited for 35 environmental violations after implosion
summary: The company has 30 days to respond to Washington’s Department of Ecology regarding the citation. Meanwhile, the state’s labor agency cited NDP for a separate safety violation at the Longview site.

title: EPA draft guidance on PFAS in biosolids draws mixed reviews
summary: The agency’s draft guidance is careful not to endorse any action taken on contamination to date. In a recent listening session, some industry voices supported the more limited approach, but environmental groups urged action.

title: DC expands food waste collection for multifamily housing
summary: The city's “smart bin” program will add another 20 collection locations. It’s part of an effort to increase multifamily composting efforts to meet DC's goal to divert 80% of waste by 2040.

title: Rumpke, PureCycle talk polypropylene PCR partnerships
summary: The companies say their work together has helped fuel new PCR uptake from packaging companies like IPL Schoeller, which needs to meet state mandates.

title: GFL Environmental closes acquisition of Secure Waste Infrastructure
summary: The multibillion-dollar transaction was first announced in April. Final negotiations occurred on a “parallel path” with discussions surrounding take-private offers, GFL CEO Patrick Dovigi previously disclosed.

title: Viably looks to expand with Harp Renewables deal
summary: The equipment provider formerly known as Komptech Americas is looking to ramp up a broader platform of offerings, starting with a deal for the Irish digester company, said President Brandon Lapsys.

title: Paper, cardboard recycling rates were flat in 2025: AF&PA
summary: Recycling rates held steady despite declines in U.S. paper and paperboard production in 2025, which illustrates the industry’s resilience, according to the American Forest & Paper Association.

title: California legislators pass key bills affecting haulers and recyclers
summary: A bill that could change hauler franchise agreements, plus bills to manage medium-format batteries, vape waste, food donations and landfill temperature events, are nearing Gov. Gavin Newsom’s desk.

title: State regulators grapple with food depackaging rules
summary: Regulators from three states discussed the steps they’re taking to ensure depackaging equipment doesn’t add contamination to organic waste streams, during a Tuesday webinar hosted by BioCycle.

title: MIT offshoot Emvolon inks landfill-to-methanol deal with Freepoint
summary: Emvolon’s technology transforms refined landfill gas from smaller sites into methanol, a premium fuel. The company is capitalizing on growing demand for alternative fuels.
